capabilities.description: Builds Interim Payment Certificates from measured quantities against the BOQ items (P1-P5, E1-E5), applies a 5% retention per Clause 14.3, and splits the release 50% at Taking-Over and 50% at the end of the Defects Notification Period.

Tracks elapsed days against the 730-day Time for Completion (Clause 8.2), records delay events, and computes delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day, capped at 10% per Clause 8.7, with a dated running position.

Registers inspection and test plans (ITPs) and inspection records against BOQ work sections, holds acceptance status per lot, and blocks a BOQ line from being claimed until its ITP records are signed off.
Maintains a numbered register of project documents (contract, BOQ, drawings, ITPs, certificates) with revisions, file hashes, and provenance back to the uploaded source documents.

Answers clause questions (retention, delay damages, performance security, defects period) by grounding on the uploaded contract, citing document:harbourline_contract.pdf clause text, and refusing when the clause is not in the source.
Extracts and holds the BOQ item schedule (quantities, units, rates) from document:harbourline_boq.xlsx and reconciles claimed quantities against measured quantities so no line is over-claimed.
Produces the certified-amount, retention, delay-damages and ITP status position for the project, with a complete audit trail of every certificate and computation.
